'''Wildfire''' was a clone unit within the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]].

==History==
Along with [[Calm Tree/Legends|Calm Tree]] and [[Snow Wolves/Legends|Snow Wolves]], Wildfire was one of the clone units that were dispatched to aid [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]], [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] and [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]] on the [[Raid on Nuvo Vindi's laboratory/Legends|raid]] on [[Doctor/Legends|Dr.]] [[Nuvo Vindi/Legends|Nuvo Vindi's]] [[Trade Federation laboratory/Legends|laboratory]] on [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]].
